title: ETH Reclaimed $1,700 Monday. $1,860 Decides If This Bounce Is Real
subTitle:
$ETH reclaimed $1,700 into Monday — and it's leading the bounce, not $BTC.
But one level decides if this is a real bottom or just a short squeeze: $1,860.

Here's what actually happened. Saturday, $BTC wicked to $55,100 on Kraken — its weakest print since September 2024 — then reclaimed $60K the same day. Monday morning it's holding around $61,300. $ETH wicked to $1,536, reclaimed $1,700, and traded near $1,730 at the Monday open. alternative.me Fear & Greed sits at 11 — Extreme Fear. Price up, mood still on the floor. That's squeeze fuel, not euphoria.

And look at the leadership fight. On the 24h bounce, ETH is outrunning Bitcoin. Over 7 days, though, $SOL held up best of the majors while ETH lagged. Tap $SOL and compare the two charts yourself — SOL is defending $70, ETH is trying to repair a broken trend. They are not moving as one anymore.

The tension today is the ETF bid. US spot ETH ETFs bled $131.2M on Nov 19 alone (Farside), $972.6M in November through Nov 19, with BlackRock's ETHA taking $124.2M of that Thursday. ETFs were closed all weekend. Monday is the first real read on whether institutions buy this dip — or keep walking away.

On-chain tells the opposite story. Staking hit a record 36.5% of supply, with roughly 748K–837K ETH queued to enter versus only ~129K–164K queued to exit. Holders are locking up. Institutions are selling. Both can be true — and that's exactly why this bounce feels fragile.

The experts are split at the same levels. Peter Schiff warned ETH could slide toward $1,000. Tom Lee calls the slide overdone with a climb toward $2,200 in view. Coinbase Institutional's framework is cleaner: lose $1,700 and the path favours $1,520; reclaim $1,860 and the breakdown fails. History agrees with patience — in August 2024 a similar macro flush bounced fast, then needed weeks of base-building and a retest before trending.

So what do you watch? Three things. One: does ETH hold $1,700 on a daily close, or slip back toward the $1,536 weekend low? Two: today's ETF flow print — green changes the story, another big red day confirms no bid. Three: Wednesday's PCE print, with December hike odds priced high — a hot number pressures every major.

Check the $ETH chart via its cashtag before you decide anything. The bounce is real. The repair isn't — not until $1,860 goes.

Who leads from here in your view — ETH reclaiming leadership, or SOL keeping it?

I’m not better than anyone else. I just chose to play a game where I can’t be eliminated early. 🐢

Why I chose spot instead of futures 👇

1️⃣ Because this is long-term capital
The money I put in is spare money, not money for living expenses. Long-term capital needs time to work—not leverage to do the work for me. Spot lets me hold coins through both bull and bear markets, and no one can force me to sell.

2️⃣ Because mindset matters more than technique
Spot teaches me patience. Futures require iron discipline, and without a solid foundation, futures often teach you through... losses. When I’m not under threat of liquidation, I can think clearly and make decisions instead of panic-clicking at 3 a.m.

3️⃣ Because the statistics don’t favor futures
CFTC research concluded that, in general, retail traders lose money in futures markets. And in 2025, excessive leverage led to more than $150 billion in positions being forcibly liquidated. I don’t want to be someone else’s “liquidity.”  

4️⃣ Because I truly OWN the asset
With spot, you own the asset; with futures, you only own a contract. The coins stay in my wallet, and the amount doesn’t change whether the price goes up or down. 

5️⃣ Because the risks are clear
Without leverage, you can’t lose more than the amount you invested. I sleep well knowing exactly where my worst-case scenario lies. 

6️⃣ Because I can DCA
A price drop is an opportunity to lower my average cost, not a disaster. Every dip is a chance to accumulate more, and I don’t have to pay funding fees to hold my position.

Who is spot suitable for?
✅ Beginners who prioritize surviving first and getting rich later
✅ People with day jobs who don’t have time to watch charts
✅ Long-term investors who believe in the project
✅ Anyone who wants to invest and still get a good night’s sleep

title: 英伟达夜盘涨7.13%，BTC却30日跌23.4%：同一晚两个市场各说各话
subTitle:
先看数字。英伟达夜盘涨7.13%，报134.48美元，总市值3.25万亿美元。台积电夜盘涨7.03%，报341.1美元，市值1.77万亿美元。两家加起来，一夜之间新增的市值体量，比整个加密市场很多板块的总盘子还大。

同一时间窗口，加密这边是什么状态？$BTC 报61,402.32，24小时涨4.15%，但30日累计跌23.4%，7日跌5.5%，30日区间58,951.51–81,343.50。也就是说，现在这个4%的反弹，是从区间下沿附近弹起来的，离上沿还差着两万多美元。$ETH 报1,730.70，涨4.60%；$BNB 报559.51，涨3.95%。三个主流品种涨幅都在4%上下，步调一致，说明这是板块性的修复，不是某一个标的的独立行情。

真正值得盯的是情绪指标。恐贪指数11，Extreme Fear。这个读数放在BTC单日涨4%的背景下，是典型的“价格先动、情绪没跟上”。历史上这种组合通常意味着两件事：一是空头回补驱动的反弹成分偏大，二是增量资金还没进场。英伟达那边的7%是风险偏好回升的信号，但资金传导到加密需要时间，也需要通道。

再看联动逻辑。台积电和英伟达同夜涨超7%，说明驱动力在算力产业链本身，不是单一公司的孤立事件。这类行情对加密的传导路径通常有两条：一是AI叙事相关的算力、存储类标的先动；二是风险资产整体beta抬升，BTC作为高beta资产滞后跟随。目前$BTC从58,951的低点反弹到61,402，幅度约4%，属于第二条路径的早期阶段，第一条路径还没看到明显放量。

结构上，61,402这个位置的关键性在于它离30日区间下沿只有约2,450美元。反弹要成立，需要看到价格站稳并逐步抬高中枢；如果只是插针后回落，那这4%就只是噪音。$ETH 1,730.70同步涨4.60%，弹性略强于BTC，这个细微的强弱差，往往是判断资金是试探性买入还是趋势性配置的一个观察点。

📌 一句话总结：英伟达的7%是算力链的确定性，BTC的4%是情绪冰点上的修复，两者之间还隔着一层资金传导的时间差。

问题留给你们：恐贪指数11、BTC单日涨4.15%，这种“价涨情绪不涨”的组合，你更倾向于是空头回补的尾声，还是增量资金进场的前奏？说说你盯的哪个指标给出的信号。

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | Five Rules I Keep Pinned Beside My Screen—Sharing Them Just as They Are
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, people forget every bit of wisdom, so I wrote these down and stuck them up:

1. Write down your stop-loss level before opening a position. If you can’t, don’t open one.
2. Keep each trade’s loss to no more than 2% of your capital. No exceptions.
3. Never add to a losing position or average down.
4. After three consecutive losing trades, stop for the day. Watch, but don’t trade.
5. Withdraw some of your profits. The money you take out is cash; what you leave behind is peace of mind.

That’s all five. Not one of them is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they read the market wrong—it’s that their execution slips. Let’s keep each other accountable.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Getting Rich Slowly: What Compounding Really Looks Like in Crypto
translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who actually keep their money in this market are the ones who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day adds up to 12 times your money over 250 trading days in a year. At a steady 10% a month,
you’d be up 30 times after three years. It doesn’t sound thrilling, but it has one remarkable quality—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. You have to wait for the right market conditions, but discipline is up to you. Don’t set your goal
as “double your money this week.” Set it as “make no major mistakes this week.” The money from the former is given to you by the market;
the skill behind the latter is yours. The market is open every day, but only those who preserve their capital are qualified to keep playing.

BTC bounced 11% from 55K, and everyone’s looking for “catch-up coins”—but the ones that have lagged the most may be the ones you should avoid 🤔

The short version:
The coin most likely to catch up in this rally is $ETH.
The most hyped $SOL  looks more like a fake bounce,
while laggard $XRP  is “unwanted,” not “just waiting its turn.”

(Binance spot, 12 days ago → now)
BTC 74,015 → 61,320 (-17%), up 11% from the low

1️⃣ ETH: Fell less than BTC, bounced more than BTC
Down 16% over 12 days, up 12% from the low of 1,538, now around 1,730.
Here’s the key: the price is rising, but the futures funding rate is negative,
which means short sellers are still paying long sellers.
The price is rising, but shorts still aren’t giving up—this setup is most likely to get squeezed higher.

2️⃣ SOL: It looks like there’s volume, but longs are overcrowded
Up 10% from the low, now around 71.4.
But the long/short ratio of Binance futures accounts is around 3.5 (about 2.1 for BTC),
and open interest has fallen from around 8.94 million to 7.87 million coins over 8 days, shrinking all the way.
Retail traders are crowded into longs while big money is pulling out.
I’d rather wait for a pullback than chase this kind of bounce.

3️⃣ XRP: Being a laggard doesn’t mean it’ll catch up
It’s bounced just 8.6% from the low, now around 0.934, and still can’t get back above $1.
If it can’t keep up when the broader market bounces, buyers aren’t here.
“Most resilient” and “first to rise” are two different things.

My take:
Early in a rebound, what matters isn’t “which coin has risen the least,”
but “which coin’s rise is most resisted by short sellers.”
I’d prioritize watching how ETH performs as it holds above 1,750;
for SOL, I’d wait for the 65–68 range; I wouldn’t consider XRP until it reclaims $1.

Missiles flew over Bahrain on Saturday night. Crypto barely blinked — and now oil has answered too.

Iran's Revolutionary Guard says it hit two US Patriot radar sites at the al-Riffa and Awali bases with missiles and drones. Bahrain says its defences intercepted several attacks, a fire broke out at a civilian industrial facility on Sitra Island, and two people were injured. Washington says no US personnel or facilities were damaged. An all-clear has been issued.

And the market? $ETH is $1,728.88, up 4.0% in 24 hours, holding above $1,700 after touching $1,752 today. $BTC is $61,312, up 3.5%, still above $61,000. $SOL is $71.42, up 3.0%, holding $70.

The oil test I was waiting for this morning is in too. Brent reopened and slipped to about $92.30 instead of spiking — even with the Houthis claiming a hit on a Saudi refinery on Sunday, and Trump saying he leans toward resuming strikes on Iran after the New Year if there is no deal. Crude is still flowing through the Gulf.

I have seen a lot of weekends where a headline like this sends everything red by Monday morning. This time the bounce held through it. That tells me last week's selling was already exhausted — or that traders are waiting for the next move before deciding. Bahrain hosts the US Navy's Fifth Fleet, and this was the fourth attack there in six days, so the story is far from over.

So the market held $60,000 through a missile attack, and oil did not even spike. Does that make you more confident in the bounce — or more nervous about what comes next?

全线大涨3%，资金费率却在集体装死

午间的热点不在新闻里，在盘面上：四大币种集体飘红，散户群却安静得可怕。

BTC 现价 61218，24 小时 +3.2%，最低 58746.1，最高 61945.5，成交额 133.5 亿美元。从 58746.1 一路收复到 61218，这不是画门，是真实买盘。

但真正值得说的不是涨幅，是资金费率。

BTC 费率 0.004%，约等于零。ETH 更狠：价格 +3.78%，费率 -0.0023%，负的。

翻译一下：涨了三个多点，ETH 空头还在倒贴钱，多头根本没挤进来。这波不是杠杆堆出来的虚胖，是现货实打实买出来的结构。

散户的剧本永远一致：58746 那会儿喊崩，61218 这会儿开始问"还来得及吗"。低点是留给胆大的人的，现在，只能按轴点做计划。

BTC 关键位：日内轴点 60543，站稳了，多头手里有底牌。上方试金石是 62341.17——24 小时高点 61945.5 冲到附近就折返，说明上方有人等货。放量拿下 62341.17，行情加速；拿不下，就在 60543 到 62341.17 之间磨。

下方买点 59439.37。回踩不破，回调都是纸老虎；破了，58746.1 大概率被再摸一次。

ETH 才是今天的主线：1726 的价格，涨幅 3.78% 跑赢 BTC，成交额 69.7 亿美元，费率还负着。涨得比大盘猛、杠杆却没发热，这种组合说明行情远没到拥挤的地步。上方看 1754.82，今天高点 1752 已经贴脸，就差临门一脚；下方 1669.68 是分界线。

XRP 别问，问就是 +1.3%，全场垫底。别人涨 3 个点它涨 1 个点，0.94 都摸不利索，就当没看见。

BNB +3.1%，稳，但 2.5 亿美元的成交额说明它今天只是配角。

方向：多头占优。不是感觉，是结构——价涨、费率冷、量能实。拥挤的上涨才危险，没人上杠杆的上涨，反而有后劲。

回调不是风险，跌破 59439.37 才是。价格说明一切，情绪一文不值。
